name: rad-para
description: Guidance for one-person PARA organization, reviews, summaries, and handoffs. It has no sync service or app connector and can misclassify sparse notes.

interface.shortDescription: Review and organize a local PARA note system.
interface.longDescription: Guidance for one-person PARA work: organization, read-only audits, reviews, summaries, output assembly, handoffs, and file moves through an approved ledger. It has no sync service, scheduler, or app connector, and sparse context can cause wrong classifications.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up or repair my PARA second brain.
Audit my PARA folders and explain what needs attention.
Run a weekly PARA review briefing.
Apply progressive summarization to these notes.
